messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert,

Our comments on the draft contract are limited. Our main points: deposit to be held as stakeholder (please); completion period of 20 working days is acceptable; and we'd like a modest retention pending resolution of the first-floor service charge query. We'll send our redline shortly.

Best,
James

messages.subject: RE: Project Sable - contract mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Our amended draft is attached, showing tracked changes. In summary: we have shortened the completion period to 15 working days; the deposit remains held as agent (our client is firm on this); and we have tightened the rent arrears recovery clause. On the service charge item, our client is content to offer a £20,000 retention pending resolution, which we will reflect in the completion statement.

Grateful for your client's agreement so we can finalise for exchange w/c 20 October.

Kind regards,
Robert
